question: Which of the following states ranked first in the Export Preparedness Index 2020 released by Niti Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Gujarat has topped the Niti Aayog's Export Preparedness Index 2020 with a score of 75.19 followed by Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu in the second and third places respectively. 
 
• NITI Aayog in partnership with the Institute of Competitiveness released the Export Preparedness Index (EPI) on 26 August 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Among the landlocked states, 

 
 
• Rajasthan has performed the best, followed by Telangana and Haryana.
 
 
 
• Among the Himalayan states, 
 
 
• Uttrakhand has performed the best, followed by Tripura and Himachal.
 
 
 
• Among theUnion Territories, 
 
 
• Delhi has performed the best, followed by Goa and Chandigarh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Information about NITI Aayog:

 
• Stands for National Institution for Transforming India. It was a replacement for the Planning Commission of India instituted in 1950. NITI Aayog is the premier policy Think Tank of the Government of India.
 
• Founded: January 1, 2015.
 
• Chairperson: Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi.
 
• Vice-Chairperson: **Suman K Bery**.
 
• Chief Executive Officer: **BVR Subrahmanyam**.
